completeness.why: All five provider link functions now only pass their own data to linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the whole sequence (upgrade with missing-account throw or insert plus transfer payee, initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event); the preserved differences (file id, mask/official_name, Akahu's tables) are explicit arguments, and the unreachable EnableBanking id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters match the real variation (bank key and institution, sync source, new-account fields, optional cloudFileId, syncedTables), making the preserved inconsistencies explicit; minor nits are the hand-written syncSource union instead of the existing provider type and the bank lookup pulled inside, which drops the Enable Banking bank-key comment.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed into linkBankSyncAccount; only the small institution/newAccountFields argument literals and their comment repeat at the call sites.
